name: Audience field
summary: A labelled text, number or dropdown field on the audience phone: the deck-ink label above, wrapped around the shared DS field (counted input, counted textarea, select), which it names for a screen reader.
highlights: Label above a DS field, in the deck ink
The label becomes the field's accessible name
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-field> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Field
spec.value: the DS field unchanged: opaque white fill, fixed #1A1A1A ink (deck-independent, so a dark deck is never white-on-white); 56px with 16px text at size touch

spec.label: Lock
spec.value: with lock-key, the control is disabled and the submitted value restored

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: label
props.desc: The field label (translated). Becomes the slotted control's aria-label unless it has its own

props.name: (slot)
props.desc: One DS field: <aha-counted-input size="touch">, <aha-counted-input type="number" maxlength="none" size="touch">, <aha-counted-textarea size="touch"> or <aha-select size="touch">

whenToUse.when: a short line (a name, a word); type="number" for a number
an open answer over several lines
a short fixed list where chips will not fit; prefer chips when every choice fits on screen

opinion.note: A placeholder is not a label: it vanishes as the participant types. Only a field that is the whole screen, directly under its question, may go bare, and then it still needs an aria-label. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-audience-field[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var l=cs(q('.label'));var f=el.querySelector('aha-counted-input');return{labelSize:l.fontSize,labelInk:l.color,gap:cs(el).rowGap,fieldHeight:Math.round(f.getBoundingClientRect().height)+'px',named:f.getAttribute('aria-label')};})()
